action.prompt: cases.jsonl changed. Run `~/.strands-ship/bin/ss cases check` and show me the errors, the counts and how many cases are unsigned. Do not sign off cases for me.

Safety code or curated data changed, so results/MEASURE.md is out of date. Tell me, and offer to run `~/.strands-ship/bin/ss measure` (it calls Bedrock about 120 times). If I made the change to fix a failing case, remind me to add an entry to FAILURES.md.
